title: Detecting Suspected Pump Thrombosis in Left Ventricular Assist Devices via Acoustic Analysis.
summary: Among 13 HVAD recipients, reported accuracy was 88.9% and sensitivity 90.9%; post-thrombolysis recordings suggested abnormalities not identified by reference pump-power or biomarker measures. The small suspected-thrombosis series and post-treatment observations are not independent prospective validation or proof of clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Acoustic features from chest recordings were selected with LDH-based correlation analysis and used in logistic regression to detect suspected left-ventricular-assist-device pump thrombosis.
